kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Rs 131.69 = lowest listed-peer P/E in the DRHP (Escorts Kubota 23.35x, p. 156) x FY26 EPS Rs 5.64. An illustrative reference, not a price band; no band exists. The only transaction price in the DRHP is Rs 1,547 per pre-bonus Rs 10 share (about Rs 33.63 per Rs 5 share after the 22:1 bonus and split), used for the promoter business purchase in 2025 (p. 388).

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: FY26 operating cash flow Rs 26.85 m against PAT Rs 313.90 m (8.6%); FY26 working capital absorbed Rs 445.46 m of inventory and Rs 281.35 m of other assets. Cumulative FY24-26 CFO/PAT 69.7% (CFO Rs 281.93 m / PAT Rs 404.39 m) on a mixed standalone/consolidated series.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Both plants stand on land leased from the promoters to 31-Mar-2055 (Cheema 19.47 acres; Dehlon 16.20 acres, Rs 0.08 m a month, +15% every 3 years), and the Rs 716.64 m expansion is on the Dehlon land. Company lent Rs 55.00 m to promoters in FY26 (balance at 31-Mar-26). Three patents assigned by promoter Dharam Singh on 21-Sep-2026 at below fair value (p. 56). Business bought from promoter proprietorships for Rs 324.57 m paid in shares at Rs 1,547 per Rs 10 share (p. 388).

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: Goodwill Rs 4.55 m restated (0.6% of tangible net worth Rs 704.74 m). The proforma balance sheet (p. 91) shows goodwill Rs 65.66 m at 31-Mar-25 and a capital reserve of Rs 32.98 m at 31-Mar-24; the restated note records goodwill of Rs 3.05 m + Rs 1.50 m. Purchase accounting differs between the two presentations.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top customer (Seth Agro Industries, not a disclosed related party) 25.21% of FY26 revenue; top-10 50.04%. Northern and Central states 93.99% of revenue. Supply side: top-10 suppliers 40.53% of FY26 raw material cost (76.68% in FY25 when promoter firms supplied); no definitive long-term agreements with suppliers or customers.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: CARO 2020 / Rule 11(g): accounting software had no audit-trail feature at database level until January 2026 (FY25 and FY26 reports). No change of statutory auditor (Anup Kumar Jain & Co) in the last three years.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: Promoters and executive directors were in the past disqualified as directors because of a directorship in Jaggatjit Agro Private Limited, which had not filed financial statements or annual returns; the company also lists past delays in RoC filings with adjudication applications.

focus.title: SME conditions
focus.detail: Offer is under Regulation 6(2) (does not meet 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(c)): at least 75% to QIBs, no more than 15% non-institutional and 10% retail, with refund if 75% cannot be allotted to QIBs. OFS of 3,100,000 shares by promoter Jagatjit Singh.

focus.title: Firm means of finance
focus.detail: Capex orders: none placed for any of the Rs 716.64 m (100% unplaced); quotations valid for limited periods. Monitoring agency to be appointed before RHP.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -52.9% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: 22:1 bonus (allotted after 27-May-2026) and 2-for-1 split are applied to all periods: EPS Rs 5.64 = Rs 313.90 m / 55,650,984 shares; NAV Rs 12.75 = Rs 709.29 m / 55,650,984 shares. Consistent across the Basis for Offer Price.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 130.30 m on FY26 PBT Rs 444.12 m (29.3%); cumulative FY24-26 current tax 26.1% of cumulative PBT. Profit is taxed in cash.

comfort.title: Revaluation reserve
comfort.detail: No revaluation reserve shown in the restated balance sheets.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 71.70 m (GST demands Rs 22.67 m, other Rs 6.50 m, bank guarantees Rs 42.35 m) = 10.1% of net worth Rs 709.29 m.
